OC of Cantonment Police Station Taken into DB Custody Following Viral Audio

Mo. Rakibul Hasan, the withdrawn Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Cantonment Police Station in Dhaka, has been taken to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Detective Branch (DB) office for questioning over a controversial audio recording that has gone viral on social media. He was taken to the DB office on Minto Road on Thursday night. According to DB sources, he was questioned as part of an inquiry into the viral audio.

Earlier, after the audio spread on social media, Rakibul Hasan was removed from his position as OC of Cantonment Police Station for administrative reasons and attached to the Central Reserve Office under the Administration Division of the DMP headquarters. Subsequently, a three-member investigation committee was formed to examine the content of the audio and verify its authenticity. According to reports, the committee includes one DB official and two officials from the DMP headquarters.

Several media outlets have reported that the audio circulating on social media contains conversations about sensitive issues, including the possibility of Sheikh Hasina returning to the country, the capabilities of the police, and the positions of various officials. Reports also claim that the audio contains statements regarding alleged financial transactions related to police postings. However, importantly, the authenticity of the audio has not yet been independently verified.

Meanwhile, in a social media post, Rakibul Hasan claimed that the viral audio was created using artificial intelligence and circulated with the intention of framing him. As a result, the investigation is focusing not only on what was allegedly said in the audio, but also on whether the recording is genuine, whose voice is heard in it, and whether the conversation actually involved the concerned police official.

The matter is therefore currently at the stage of a formal inquiry. His removal from duty and questioning by the DB should not be interpreted as confirmation that any allegations against him have been proven. The investigation committee is expected to establish the actual facts regarding the source and authenticity of the audio and Rakibul Hasan’s alleged connection to it.

However, the circulation of such a sensitive audio involving a police official on social media, followed shortly by administrative action and an investigation, has made the incident significant. Attention is now focused on the outcome of the investigation. If the audio is found to be genuine, it would raise one set of questions; if it is found to have been artificially created, how it was produced and circulated would itself become a serious subject of investigation.

🛡️ Google Gemini AI Hacked 3 Real Companies during a Cybersecurity Test | Details: https://t.co/uK3SV3yCTG

Google has confirmed that its Gemini artificial intelligence model accessed protected systems belonging to three companies during a cybersecurity evaluation after a testing error exposed the agent to the public internet.

The incident shows how an autonomous AI system can move beyond a sandbox when controls, target definitions, and network isolation fail, even without instructions to attack organizations. Gemini was directed to investigate software associated with a fictional company. 

However, the fictional business shared its name with a real organization, while internet connectivity that should not have been available was accidentally enabled.
